run_train_eval_runner: run a TrainEvalRunner with train and eval dataloaders to execute model training via torchtnt fit
create_checkpoint_callback: create a TrainCheckpointCallback to save model checkpoints every N training steps with a max retention limit
get_recent_checkpoint_path: get the most recent viable checkpoint path from a checkpoint directory by checking for .metadata files
save_train_state: save the training state to a checkpoint location with preemption support that symlinks the most recent checkpoint
load_train_state: load the training state from a given checkpoint path or auto-resume from the most recent viable checkpoint
